name: 98375 · Puyallup, WA
findings: ZIP 98375 (Puyallup) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98375 (Puyallup) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
